# Texas Five Star Paint & Body
Family-owned auto body shop in Garland, TX, delivering dealership-quality collision repair, custom paint, and classic auto restoration with an artist's touch.

## About Us
We have 15+ years of experience, over 1,000 satisfied customers, and a perfect 5-star rating on Google (500+ reviews). We handle everyday drivers, luxury/exotic vehicle owners (Porsche, Mercedes, BMW, Bentley), and classic car enthusiasts.

## Core Services
- **Collision Repair**: Complete post-accident repair, frame straightening, and computerized color-matching.
- **Custom Paint & Refinishing**: High-end candy, pearl, metallic, and matte finishes. Full-body color changes.
- **Auto Restoration**: Frame-off and rotisserie restoration for classic and muscle cars to factory specs.
- **Paintless Dent Repair (PDR)**: Same-day hail damage and dent removal preserving factory paint.
- **Headlight Restoration**: Removing oxidation and sealing for UV protection.
- **Lease Return Reconditioning**: Repairing scuffs, scratches, and dings to avoid dealership return fees.

## Pricing & Insurance
We provide free, no-obligation estimates. We work with all major insurance companies and handle the entire claims process. For qualifying insurance repairs, we offer up to $500 deductible forgiveness. For more details on pricing and insurance, see [Pricing](/pricing.md).
